highlights: Company Timezone Day Boundaries, Audit Log Filters, and 4xx Input Error Mapping
changes: Company Timezone Day Boundaries, Audit Log Filters, and 4xx Input Error Mapping

Company Timezone Day Boundaries (Bug #127): Added database migration 000002 with company_today(), company_date(), and company_day_start_utc() SQL helpers reading company timezone setting (default Asia/Beirut) and migrated all 41 CURRENT_DATE queries across queries.sql (expiry filters, renewal forecast, aging, and month-to-date trends)

Audit Log Filters & Paging Resilience (Bug #128): Fixed audit logs main query by replacing non-existent u.is_active with u.status::text = 'active', cast all SQL parameters, clamped pagination limits (1..1000) and offset (>= 0), stripped NUL bytes from search, and returned 404 for non-existent audit logs

Safe Input Error Mapping & Validation (Bug #129): Added pkg/httperr middleware RejectNUL returning 400 for NUL characters in queries or JSON payloads, mapped SQLSTATE constraint errors (22001, 23502, 23505) to 400/409/404 across 11 entity handlers, validated status enum filters, enforced required customer_id and date on invoices, and defaulted zone is_active to true
Frontend Documentation & Security Tab Polish: Merged bug testing documentation (bug-testing-before-launch.md) and improved date formatting for security logs
